card.name: "The" in syringe handling steps
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "-connected" in "pre-connected") right after a verb like remove, peel off, or at, in step-by-step instructions for syringes, pens and needles. The next word is usually a device part such as tip cap, needle cover, or seal.
